whatIsVisa.title: What is a Mainland UAE Visa?
whatIsVisa.paragraph1: A Mainland UAE Visa allows foreign nationals to live and work anywhere in the UAE without free zone restrictions. It is the most flexible visa option for professionals, entrepreneurs, and investors looking to establish themselves or expand their businesses in the UAE.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about the Mainland UAE Visa. Still have questions? We're one message away.

items.q: What is a Mainland UAE Visa?
items.a: A Mainland UAE Visa is a residence permit issued under a mainland company license, allowing foreign nationals to live, work, and conduct business anywhere in the UAE without restrictions imposed by free zones.

items.q: Who can apply for a Mainland UAE Visa?
items.a: Entrepreneurs, investors, business owners, skilled professionals, employees of mainland companies, and their family members or domestic workers can all apply.

items.q: What are the main types of Mainland UAE Visas?
items.a: There are 4 main types: Investor/Partner Visa, Employment Visa, Dependent Visa, and Domestic Worker Visa — each tailored to specific profiles.

items.q: What are the advantages of a Mainland UAE Visa?
items.a: Key advantages include freedom to operate across all 7 emirates, unlimited potential for growth, government project access, family sponsorship, banking credibility, and long-term stability.

items.q: How long is a Mainland UAE Visa valid?
items.a: A Mainland Visa is valid for 2 years and is renewable indefinitely. It also offers a pathway to the UAE Golden Visa for long-term stability.

items.q: What documents are required for a Mainland UAE Visa?
items.a: You'll typically need a valid passport (6+ months), recent photos, entry permit, trade license copy, establishment card, employment contract, medical certificate, and completed Emirates ID form.

items.q: What is the step-by-step process to obtain a Mainland UAE Visa?
items.a: It includes: Company registration & trade license → Document preparation → Application submission → Medical fitness & Emirates ID → Visa stamping.

items.q: Can a Mainland UAE Visa holder sponsor family members?
items.a: Yes. Mainland visa holders can sponsor spouses, children, and eligible dependents. We handle the entire family sponsorship process end-to-end.

items.q: How does Setup Zone Dubai assist with Mainland UAE Visas?
items.a: We provide full assistance — consultation, documentation, application submission, medical coordination, Emirates ID, and final stamping. Plus family sponsorship, renewals, and PRO services.

items.q: Can Mainland UAE Visa holders operate business across all Emirates?
items.a: Yes. A mainland visa allows you to operate freely across all seven emirates without the geographical restrictions that free zone visas impose.
